decisions.reason: The FAQ changes stated in message 184 are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the email-transport scope expansion requires no additional FAQ state change.
Email-link dashboard access is consistent with the existing simple email authentication requirement and does not change its authentication method or scope.
The certificate contents and reading links from message 184 are already captured by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE; the transport scope change adds no further certificate behavior.
Wallet provisioning and access paths are already fully captured by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE and are not altered by the transactional-email scope expansion.
The confirmation-email display surface is already captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; no additional referral-code state change is entailed.
The read-only PDF.js viewer and its email entry point are already represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE; email transport scope does not further modify reader behavior.
The same-message MODIFY already replaces claim-based collection with automatic direct wallet transfer and removes all obsolete claim attributes.
The same-message MODIFY already captures SIWE dashboard access using the Transak-created wallet; the email-transport scope change requires no further wallet-authentication update.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already updates its reward copy to include dashboard and email notifications plus direct wallet delivery.
Transactional email delivery does not affect whether leaderboard and pool-value APIs remain publicly accessible without authentication.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already adds dashboard and email winner notifications and the required email component.
The email-transport scope expansion does not change the Small Block prize mechanism; the only prize-rule wording in message 184 is already reflected by its same-message MODIFY.
